note: Machine-readable transcription of decision rules that were already pre-registered in the cited protocol documents. Entries 1-4 were transcribed on 2026-11-13, after Experiments 005, 006 and 008 had run and been reviewed. They are copies, not new pre-registrations: each quotes its source verbatim and pins the source document hash. No threshold, arm or condition was chosen or changed here. A future protocol must add its entry here BEFORE its freeze and list this file in its freeze.

hypotheses.statement: Global workflow monitoring improves detection over local action monitoring (deterministic rule monitors, held-out dataset).

source.quoted_text: H1 is supported on this dataset only if all three hold: 1. global recall exceeds local recall (primary metric, §8); 2. the global false-positive rate is at most local FPR + 1/12 (that is, at most one additional false positive among the 12 legitimate workflows); 3. no observation-boundary check fails (§6). Otherwise H0 is retained.

conditions.text: Global FPR is at most Local FPR + 1/12

hypotheses.statement: The rq1-protocol-1 decision rule, applied to LLM Local vs. LLM Global on the held-out dataset.

source.quoted_text: Decision rule: the same three conditions as rq1-protocol-1 §1, applied to LLM Local vs. LLM Global. They are applied only when all of the following hold: live mode; the complete frozen held-out dataset; seed 0; no UNKNOWN workflow. Otherwise the comparison is descriptive.

conditions.text: LLM Global recall exceeds LLM Local recall
LLM Global FPR is at most LLM Local FPR + 1/12

hypotheses.statement: Global workflow monitoring beats local monitoring on the 60-workflow follow-up set with low FPR (deterministic rule monitors).

source.quoted_text: H1: Global recall exceeds Local recall, with observed Global FPR at most 10% and no higher than Local FPR on this challenge set. All integrity checks must pass before this is descriptive support. Otherwise retain H0 for this set.

hypotheses.role_note: In an LLM run (008 protocol) the rules arms are a non-blind reproduction of Experiment 006, not new evidence.

conditions.text: Observed Global FPR is at most 10%
Global FPR is no higher than Local FPR

hypotheses.statement: An LLM monitor with global workflow context beats the same LLM with local context on the 60-workflow set, with low FPR.

source.quoted_text: H1-LLM requires all of the following on this set: LLM Global recall exceeds LLM Local recall; observed LLM Global FPR is at most 10%; LLM Global FPR is no higher than LLM Local FPR; every integrity check passes. If H1-LLM holds, it is descriptive support only. Otherwise H0 is retained for this set. [...] Any UNKNOWN prediction makes the run INCONCLUSIVE.
